content.title: About
content.content: Light chocolate syrup is a thick, sweet sauce made from cocoa, sugar, and water, often flavored with vanilla or caramel. It is used to drizzle over ice cream, desserts, drinks, and baked goods, providing a rich chocolate taste without the bitterness of dark cocoa.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light chocolate syrup contains less cocoa mass than traditional dark syrup, giving it a milder flavor.
It is a staple in American cafés for making milkshakes and frappés.
The high sugar content acts as a preservative, allowing the syrup to last up to 12 months in the fridge.
Some recipes replace sugar with corn syrup for a thinner consistency.
In many coffee shops the syrup is served as decorative "chocolate ribbons" on dessert plates.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa provides flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Sugar offers a quick source of energy, useful before intense activity.

items.title: Mood improvement
items.content: Cocoa stimulates serotonin and endorphin production, enhancing mood.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Small amounts of cocoa can promote gastric juice secretion.

items.title: Convenient use
items.content: The syrup dissolves easily in both cold and hot liquids, making drink preparation fast.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Excessive intake may lead to weight gain, elevated blood glucose, and tooth decay.

items.title: Cocoa allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to cocoa components.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Certain brands add artificial flavors and preservatives that some consumers prefer to avoid.

items.title: Hyperactivity in children
items.content: Sugar can increase hyperactivity in sensitive kids.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drizzle the syrup over ice cream, stir into coffee, blend into milkshakes, swirl into yogurt or oatmeal, or use it to flavor cake batter and frosting.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a tightly sealed bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, store in the refrigerator and use within 6–12 months.
